mapper.select: select concat(tsp.name,'-',tsp.screen_dept,'-',tsp.year) as name,tsp.screen_dept,tsp.id screenPointId from tb_screen_point tsp left join tb_user_screen_point tusp on tusp.screen_point_id=tsp.id where tusp.user_id=#{id} and tusp.deleted=0 and tsp.deleted=0 group by tsp.name,tsp.screen_dept,tsp.year,tsp.id

select tsp.name,tsp.screen_dept as agency,tsp.worker,tsp.collect_worker,tsp.ppd_worker,tsp.drct_worker,tsp.sputum_worker, tsp.electrocardiogram_worker,tsp.electrocardiogram_worker,tsp.diagnosis_worker,tsp.year from tb_screen_point tsp where tsp.id=#{screenPointId} and tsp.deleted=0
SELECT su.id, su.username AS name, su.pwd_md5 AS pwd, su.nickname FROM system_users su JOIN system_users su2 ON su.screen_point_id = su2.screen_point_id WHERE su2.id=#{id} AND su2.deleted=0

SELECT sr.name FROM system_role sr LEFT JOIN system_user_role sur ON sr.id = sur.role_id WHERE sur.user_id = #{id} AND sr.code in ('capital','collect_group','ppd_group','dr/ct_group','sputum_group','electrocardiogram_group','experiment_group','diagnos_group') AND sur.deleted = 0 AND sr.deleted=0
select id,username name,pwd_md5 pwd,nickname from system_users where id=#{id} and deleted=0
